zh: 今天，全球科技界发生了两件颠覆时代的大事。
en: Today, two era-defining events happened in the global tech world.

zh: 彻底宣告纯AI落地物理世界AGI时代正式到来
en: A definitive announcement: pure AI has entered the physical world, and the AGI era has officially arrived.

zh: 一件是OpenAI重磅发布的GPT-6 Astra，
en: One is OpenAI's major release of GPT-6 Astra,

zh: 全新旗舰模型
en: its new flagship model.

zh: 一件是特斯拉的Cybercab无人驾驶机器人正式落地路测
en: Another is Tesla's Cybercab, an autonomous-driving robot, officially entering real-world road testing.

zh: 这两件事情叠在一起，
en: Taken together, these two events

zh: 是未来三年所有生意、所有行业、所有普通人的分水。
en: are a dividing point for all businesses, all industries, and all ordinary people over the next three years.

zh: 今天的GPT-6 Astra最核心的突破，
en: The most fundamental breakthrough in today's GPT-6 Astra

zh: 就是原生电脑操作能力。
en: is its native ability to operate a computer.

zh: 不再单纯的靠你一问一答
en: It no longer relies solely on back-and-forth questions and answers with you.

zh: 它可以直接操控电脑、浏览器、各类业务软件
en: It can directly operate computers, browsers, and all kinds of business software,

zh: 自主跑完完整业务工作
en: and independently complete the entire business task.

zh: 简单说，就是下达一个复杂的业务任务。
en: In simple terms, give it a complex business task.

zh: 它可以自己拆解任务、自主操作软件、搜集资料、
en: It can break down tasks on its own, operate software autonomously, and gather information,

zh: 排查问题、自我校对、复盘。
en: troubleshoot problems, check its own work, and review the process.

zh: 最后直接交付成品结果
en: Finally, it delivers the finished output directly.

zh: 那么做数据整理、搭建业务SOP、
en: So, it can organize data and build business SOPs,

zh: 产出获客文案、输出视觉方案
en: produce customer-acquisition copy and deliver visual proposals.

zh: 报表分析、流程优化。
en: Report analysis and process optimization.

zh: 从不会偷懒
en: It never slacks off,

zh: 不用休息
en: doesn't need rest,

zh: 不用发工资
en: and doesn't need a salary.

zh: 最关键，大幅降低人力成本。
en: Most importantly, it greatly reduces labor costs.

zh: 效率是指数级的提升
en: Efficiency improves exponentially.

zh: 这意味着，普通工人的重复性工作，
en: This means ordinary workers' repetitive tasks,

zh: 流程性工作、机械性工作全部可以被AI彻底替代
en: process-based tasks, and mechanical tasks can all be completely replaced by AI.

zh: 再看我们第二件事，特斯拉的Cybercab
en: Now let's look at our second event: Tesla's Cybercab.

zh: 一台没有方向盘、没有油门、没有刹车的车
en: A car with no steering wheel, no accelerator, and no brakes.

zh: 人类完全不能驾驶
en: Humans cannot drive it at all.

zh: 从出生，它就是一台四轮的AI机器人。
en: From birth, it is a four-wheeled AI robot.

zh: 咱们回顾这个汽车百年历史
en: Let's look back at this hundred-year history of the automobile.

zh: 从马车到燃油车、从燃油车到电动车
en: From horse-drawn carriages to gasoline cars, and from gasoline cars to electric cars.

zh: 所有设计都是服务人类驾驶员
en: Every design is made to serve the human driver.

zh: 人开车、人判断、人负责、人决策
en: Humans drive, humans judge, humans take responsibility, and humans make decisions.

zh: 哪怕是以前的辅助驾驶
en: Even with the driver-assistance systems of the past,

zh: 核心逻辑永远是人为主、AI为辅
en: the core principle is always humans in charge and AI assisting.

zh: 但Cybercab彻底推翻了百年规则
en: But Cybercab completely overturns those century-old rules.

zh: 没有人驾驶、没有人干预
en: No one drives, and no one intervenes.

zh: 眼睛是摄像头、大脑是FSD大模型
en: Its eyes are cameras, and its brain is the FSD model.

zh: 决策全部交给AI。
en: All decisions are handed over to AI.

zh: 它不再是交通工具
en: It is no longer a means of transportation.

zh: 它是走进物理现实世界的AI机器人
en: It is an AI robot entering the physical, real world.

zh: GPT-6 Astra是虚拟世界的超级智能大脑
en: GPT-6 Astra is the super-intelligent brain of the virtual world,

zh: 能在软件系统里面完成整套商业的工作
en: able to complete an entire set of business tasks inside software systems.

zh: Cybercab是现实世界的超级执行身体
en: Cybercab is the super-powered body that carries out actions in the real world.

zh: 大脑加身体，全部成熟。
en: The brain and the body are both fully mature.

zh: 这就是真正的AGI通用人工智能时代
en: This is the real era of AGI, artificial general intelligence.

zh: 发布会现场呢，直接喊出
en: At the launch event, well, they called out directly:

zh: 欢迎来到AGI时代
en: "Welcome to the AGI era."

zh: 从今天开始，AI走出屏幕，
en: Starting today, AI steps out of the screen,

zh: 走进现实，接管实体工作，
en: enters the real world, and takes over physical work,

zh: 接管商业流程
en: takes over business processes,

zh: 接管各行各业
en: and takes over every industry.

zh: 很多老板一直有个误区：AI大模型机器人，
en: Many business owners have long had a misconception: AI, large models, and robots

zh: 都是大城市大厂的事
en: are all matters for big cities and big companies,

zh: 跟我们实体店、小工厂、小店们没关系。
en: and have nothing to do with our physical stores, small factories, and small shops.

zh: 但是真正的变革，从来不是先淘汰有钱人、淘汰大厂。
en: But real change never starts by eliminating the wealthy or the big companies.

zh: 最先淘汰的是看不懂趋势
en: The first to be eliminated are those who cannot see the trends,

zh: 不敢落地
en: who don't dare to put things into practice,

zh: 还在用老方法苦熬的传统经营者。
en: traditional business operators still struggling with old methods.

zh: GPT-6 Astra现在能帮你自动获客
en: GPT-6 Astra can now help you acquire customers automatically,

zh: 自动做营销
en: do marketing automatically,

zh: 自动做设计
en: do design work automatically,

zh: 自动梳理企业SOP
en: organize your company's SOPs automatically,

zh: 自动数据分析
en: analyze data automatically,

zh: 自动优化所有的[语音不清]
en: Automatically optimize all [unclear audio].

zh: Cybercab告诉我们一个更残酷的真相
en: Cybercab reveals an even harsher truth to us:

zh: 未来拼的不再是你有多能干
en: In the future, the competition will no longer be about how capable you are,

zh: 而是你会不会用AI赋能你的生意。
en: but whether you know how to use AI to empower your business.

zh: 机器干重复的事
en: Machines do the repetitive work.

zh: 人只干决策、判断、资源、服务、经营。
en: People only handle decisions, judgment, resources, services, and business operations.

zh: AI不是未来
en: AI is not the future.

zh: AI就是现在
en: AI is right now.

zh: 不用再纠结
en: There's no need to keep agonizing

zh: AI听不懂
en: over not understanding AI,

zh: 不会用
en: not knowing how to use it,

zh: 学不会
en: or not being able to learn it.

zh: 你不需要懂技术
en: You don't need to understand technology.

zh: 你只需要懂你的行业
en: You only need to understand your industry,

zh: 你的生意
en: your business.

zh: 剩下所有繁琐、落地，
en: All the remaining tedious work and implementation,

zh: 优化、陪跑、执行，
en: optimization, hands-on support, and execution,

zh: 全部交给AI
en: can all be handed over to AI.

zh: 交给我来帮你落地
en: Leave it to me to help you put it into practice.

zh: 我在兰州专注本地企业AI
en: In Lanzhou, I focus on AI for local businesses,

zh: 全程落地陪跑
en: providing hands-on support throughout implementation.

zh: 你的门店获客
en: Customer acquisition for your store,

zh: 营销策划
en: marketing planning,

zh: 视觉设计
en: visual design,

zh: 流程简化
en: process simplification,

zh: SOP搭建
en: SOP development,

zh: 数据复盘
en: data review,

zh: 所有问题，AI全部能解决。
en: All these problems can be solved by AI.

zh: 不想被时代淘汰
en: If you don't want to be left behind by the times,

zh: 想让自己的生意降本增效
en: and want your business to cut costs and improve efficiency,

zh: 弯道超车的，评论区留下“落地”。
en: and leapfrog the competition, leave "落地" (implementation) in the comments.

zh: 我带你真正走进AI做生意的时代
en: I'll help you truly enter the era of doing business with AI.

zh: 我是超哥
en: I'm Chao Ge.

zh: 一个在兰州深耕AI实体落地的创业者
en: an entrepreneur deeply involved in bringing AI into real-world businesses in Lanzhou.
